label: Applying directly to a French grande école or private institution for autumn 2027

milestones.label: École polytechnique Bachelor - round 1 closes
milestones.note: Rounds 2 and 3 follow, so missing this is not fatal.

milestones.label: EDHEC International BBA - first of five sessions closes
milestones.note: Four later sessions run to March; rounds 1 and 2 carry eligibility for Excellence scholarships.

milestones.label: Sciences Po - second round closes
milestones.note: Results at the beginning of April 2027.

milestones.label: École polytechnique Bachelor - final round closes
ESCP, ESSEC, EDHEC, emlyon and AUP - each on its own calendar
milestones.note: Each school runs its own rounds and dates. Check each school’s admissions page.

milestones.label: IB results released
milestones.note: Every round above closes before this. Offers are made on predicted grades.

notes: Sciences Po and École polytechnique both hold interviews as part of selection. A student with a foreign diploma applies on the school's own platform rather than through Parcoursup (Sciences Po states this; École polytechnique allows either, but only one).

EDHEC's first session (closes 3 November 2026) added 2026-09-24. Dates for ESCP (rolling), ESSEC, emlyon and the American University of Paris were not published on their programme pages on 2026-09-24.
